name: GenAI Entitlement Descriptions Have Been Regenerated
description: Sent to a user to notify them that GenAI entitlement descriptions have been regenerated.
subject: Your GenAI entitlement descriptions have been regenerated
body:
GenAI entitlement descriptions regenerated

Dear $__recipient.name,

Based on the input in your GenAI Settings, entitlement descriptions have been regenerated so they more accurately reflect your context.

Descriptions regenerated: ${SedRegenerationCount}

You can review the regenerated descriptions on the GenAI Entitlement Descriptions page.

Thank you,
The $__global.productName Team
